0.original: Sisipu would send you to Thanalan to aid Tocktix once more.

1.original: The merchant Tocktix has returned to the Fishermen's Guild once more, this time in search of a desert catfish, which is a key ingredient in one of his favorite dishes. Unaware how a fisher might pull anything from sand, Sisipu recommends that you seek out U'goromuli, a dunefishing acquaintance of Tocktix's and a resident of Forgotten Springs in southern Thanalan.

2.original: Though she would never eat desert catfish herself, U'goromuli is more than happy to assist you. She advises you to seek out a fishing hole east of Byregot's Strike, near an Amalj'aa encampment, and use sand leeches to catch your quarry. Once acquired, deliver the fish to Tocktix outside the Fishermen's Guild.

3.original: Tocktix is ecstatic to receive his prized gourmet catfish. He promptly informs you that he shall waste no time in taking it to the Bismarck, where he has reserved a table for one after closing.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※The next fisher quest will be available from Sisipu upon reaching level 40.

24.original: Speak with U'goromuli at Forgotten Springs.

25.original: Deliver a desert catfish to Tocktix.

48.original: Your goblin friendlyfriend was looking for you earlier. He was hoping you'd make his fishiest fantasies come true.

49.original: He recalled a dish that tickled his fancy some years ago, and now needs you to procure the necessary fish for him.

50.original: This desert catfish, as it is apparently called, is indigenous to─and this is the truly mind-boggling part─the desert, of all places.

51.original: Tocktix spoke of a trapper named U'goromuli who'd fished one out of Forgotten Springs in the southern reaches of Thanalan. If you want that catfish, you'd best go and speak with her.

52.original: Friend of Tocktix, you say? Sure, dunefished my fair share of desert catfish.

53.original: Never eat them, though, know that much. Only ever use them as sandworm bait.

54.original: Thought of eating desert catfish hadn't occurred to me until the goblin devoured it before my eyes. Still wouldn't touch them myself.

55.original: Different fish for different folk, as they say. No problem fishing them out, though. Can even tell you how it's done.

56.original: Just comes down to the right bait in the right place. Nothing to it, really.

57.original: Easy as dropping a line with some sand leeches at the fishing hole east of Byregot's Strike, near the Amalj'aa encampment.

58.original: Not the same as sea fishing here in the dunes, mind you. Real test of your reel out here.

59.original: Trick is to hold on when it flails. Only takes one to make a day's haul. Good hunting.

60.original: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Fishbringer find tastyfresh fishcat in sandylands for friendlyfriend Tocktix?

61.original: Pshhh... Shkohhh...<hex:02100103>Tocktix is thanksgiving to fishbringer for lipsmacking fishcat!

62.original: Fishcat nosestrings make for strengthful satchelstrands.

63.original: Tocktix trades tongueflaps with Lyngsath for fancycooking of fishcat in Bismarck! Lyngsath only fancycooks after shoplock because of strengthful fishcat odor. Fishbringer makes Tocktix one happygobbie!
